title: Distinguishability and Recovery for a Doubly Sparse Spiked Wigner Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.23033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study distinguishability and recovery of a sparse rank-one signal in a spiked Wigner model with independently sparse noise through a variety of algorithms and parameter regimes. The signal and noise have separate sparsity parameters, while the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) remains of constant order as the matrix size grows. For sub-Gaussian noise and spikes whose nonzero coordinates are bounded away from zero, a leave-one-out quadratic thresholding procedure (a generalization of Ding et al., 2024) identifies the support. Sign synchronization yields exact recovery for a Rademacher spike, and spectral refinement yields strong recovery. The quadratic thresholding search parameter gives an explicit tradeoff between signal sparsity, noise sparsity, and computational cost. translated_title: 双稀疏尖峰Wigner模型的可区分性与恢复
translated_abstract: 我们通过多种算法和参数区域，研究具有独立稀疏噪声的尖峰Wigner模型中稀疏秩一信号的可区分性与恢复问题。信号和噪声具有各自独立的稀疏性参数，而信噪比（SNR）在矩阵规模增大时保持常数阶。对于亚高斯噪声以及非零坐标有界远离零的尖峰信号，一种留一二次阈值化程序（Ding等人2024年工作的推广）能够识别信号的支撑集。通过符号同步可对Rademacher尖峰实现精确恢复，通过谱精炼可实现强恢复。二次阈值化的搜索参数给出了信号稀疏性、噪声稀疏性与计算成本之间的显式权衡。我们还通过对角阈值化和二次阈值化研究了向亚高斯尖峰先验的推广。对于具有连续非零噪声的Rademacher尖峰，我们开发了一个可……
tldr: 本文研究信号与噪声均稀疏的双稀疏尖峰Wigner模型，提出留一二次阈值化、符号同步及谱精炼等算法，在信噪比保持常数阶的条件下实现了稀疏秩一信号的支撑识别、精确恢复与强恢复，并给出了信号稀疏性、噪声稀疏性与计算成本之间的显式权衡刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper studies a doubly sparse spiked Wigner model where both signal and noise are sparse, developing leave-one-out quadratic thresholding, sign synchronization, and spectral refinement algorithms that achieve support identification, exact recovery, and strong recovery at constant-order SNR, while explicitly characterizing the tradeoff between signal sparsity, noise sparsity, and computational cost.
